Who We Are

Our History & Community

Newcomb & District Cricket Club is a community cornerstone in the east Geelong area, competing in the Geelong Cricket Association (GCA). We run senior men's, senior women's, and junior programs out of Grinter Reserve, 141 Coppards Road, Moolap, providing accessible cricket for players of all backgrounds and skill levels.

The club proudly holds Good Sports accreditation, reflecting our commitment to a safe, responsible, and supportive sporting environment for members, families, and volunteers.

We share a long-standing community bond with the Newcomb Power Football Netball Club, our neighbours at Grinter Reserve, working together to serve the local sporting community across seasons.

Where We Train

World-Class Facilities

The Peter ‘Skinny’ Harrison Training Facility, opened August 2024, gives our players access to seven state-of-the-art practice lanes at Grinter Reserve.

Public Synthetic Lanes

3

Open-access synthetic lanes available to all community members and casual use. Perfect for social cricket and school groups.

Club Reserved Turf Lanes

4

Premium turf lanes reserved for club training. Used by senior men's, women's, and junior squads for structured practice.

Named in Honour of

Peter ‘Skinny’ Harrison

Opened August 2024. A tribute to a beloved club figure, this facility sets a new standard for community cricket infrastructure in the Geelong region.
